description: This file contains C++ source code implementing Python bindings for PyTorch autograd tensor methods, including function wrappers, method definitions, and internal logic for tensor operations and conversions.

methods.name: THPVariable__is_view
methods.description: Checks if the tensor is a view.

methods.name: THPVariable_apply_
methods.description: Applies a function to the tensor, with special handling if requires_grad is true.

methods.name: THPVariable_size
methods.description: Returns the size of the tensor for a given dimension or name.

methods.name: THPVariable_stride
methods.description: Returns the stride of the tensor for a given dimension or name.

methods.name: THPVariable_get_device
methods.description: Returns the device of the tensor.

methods.name: THPVariable_has_names
methods.description: Checks if the tensor has named dimensions.

methods.name: THPVariable_data_ptr
methods.description: Returns the data pointer of the tensor.

methods.name: THPVariable_storage_offset
methods.description: Returns the storage offset of the tensor.

methods.name: THPVariable_dim
methods.description: Returns the number of dimensions of the tensor.

methods.name: THPVariable_numel
methods.description: Returns the total number of elements in the tensor.

methods.name: dispatch_contiguous
methods.description: Returns a contiguous copy of the tensor with specified memory format.

methods.name: THPVariable_contiguous
methods.description: Wraps the contiguous operation, avoiding dispatch overhead.

methods.name: dispatch_copy_
methods.description: Copies data from another tensor into this tensor.

methods.name: maybe_warn_requires_grad
methods.description: Warns if converting a tensor with requires_grad=True to a scalar.

methods.name: THPVariable_copy_
methods.description: Performs in-place copy from another tensor.

methods.name: dispatch_to
methods.description: Dispatches tensor to a specified device, dtype, or with options.

methods.name: THPVariable_float_scalar
methods.description: Converts tensor to Python float.

methods.name: THPVariable_complex_scalar
methods.description: Converts tensor to Python complex.

methods.name: THPVariable_integral_scalar
methods.description: Converts tensor to Python int.

methods.name: THPVariable_index_scalar
methods.description: Converts a single-element integer tensor to Python index.

methods.name: dispatch_invert
methods.description: Bitwise NOT operation on tensor.

methods.name: THPVariable_invert
methods.description: Wraps the invert operation.

methods.name: dispatch_to (overloaded)
methods.description: Various overloads to move tensor to device/dtype.

methods.name: THPVariable_cpu
methods.description: Moves tensor to CPU.

methods.name: dispatch_nonzero
methods.description: Returns non-zero indices of tensor.

methods.name: dispatch_nonzero_numpy
methods.description: Returns non-zero indices as numpy array.

methods.name: THPVariable_nonzero
methods.description: Wraps nonzero operations, with options for tuple or numpy output.

methods.name: THPVariable_cuda
methods.description: Moves tensor to CUDA device.

methods.name: THPVariable_mtia
methods.description: Moves tensor to MTIA device.

methods.name: THPVariable_xpu
methods.description: Moves tensor to XPU device.

methods.name: THPVariable_ipu
methods.description: Moves tensor to IPU device.

methods.name: THPVariable_to_type
methods.description: Converts tensor to specified scalar type.

methods.name: THPVariable_byte
methods.description: Converts tensor to byte type.

methods.name: THPVariable_char
methods.description: Converts tensor to char type.

methods.name: THPVariable_element_size
methods.description: Returns element size in bytes.

methods.name: THPVariable_numpy
methods.description: Converts tensor to numpy array.

methods.name: THPVariable_requires_grad_
methods.description: Sets requires_grad flag.

methods.name: THPVariable_set_
methods.description: Sets tensor data from storage, tensor, or storage with offset, size, stride.

methods.name: THPVariable_short
methods.description: Converts tensor to short type.

methods.name: THPVariable_size
methods.description: Returns tensor size.

methods.name: THPVariable_storage
methods.description: Returns the storage of the tensor.

methods.name: THPVariable_storage_offset
methods.description: Returns the storage offset.

methods.name: THPVariable_stride
methods.description: Returns tensor stride.

methods.name: THPVariable_tolist
methods.description: Converts tensor to Python list.

methods.name: THPVariable_type
methods.description: Returns tensor type or converts to specified type.

methods.name: THPVariable_bool_scalar
methods.description: Converts tensor to Python bool.

methods.name: THPVariable___eq__
methods.description: Equality comparison, with numpy support if available.
